digest.component_or_area: binding store and rich-emission state management
propositions: Production rich-emission state mutation currently goes through all_bindings() query instead of the narrow BindingStore.note_rich_emit facade method.
The docstring at _observe_rich_reemit falsely claims binding_store.py cannot carry a narrower accessor, when S2 T3 added such an accessor and the file is no longer at module-size cap.
No production code should mutate a binding reached through all_bindings(); only named facade methods should perform binding writes.
ADR 0099 must record the realized pre-observation repair boundary, explicit-unretire reversal rules, and prohibition on broad tickets-branch staging.
The rich-emission call site invocation must be positioned between the staleness gate and first fetch in reconcile.py, not in run_differs.py, per the documented repair oracle.
